fixes.explanation: Not this one, friend. The man in verse 4 killed his neighbor accidentally, without intending to harm him. The passage does turn to someone else in verse 11: a man who hates his neighbor, lies in wait, attacks him and kills him. Keep those two men apart and the rest of the chapter gets a lot easier.

problems.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.
“Revenge belongs to a different man” suggests the other man acted for revenge. The passage says he hated his neighbor and lay in wait, but does not say he killed him for revenge.
